features.name: Read Page Count
features.description: Opens the three-page fixture and reports the page count, with no page content extracted.

features.name: Read Metadata
features.description: Opens the fixture and reads the document title and author from the information dictionary.

features.name: Extract Page Text
features.description: Opens the fixture and extracts the text of the first page, including content stream decoding.

features.name: Write Text Document
features.description: Produces a one-page document with a heading and twenty body lines, and saves it to a byte array.

features.name: Write Table Document
features.description: Produces a one-page document holding a thirty-row, three-column table with a header row, and saves it to a byte array.

features.name: Write Multi Page Document
features.description: Produces a four-page document whose pages each carry a heading and twelve lines, and saves it to a byte array.
